questions: The second pass was typed by the same build session as the first, so it is not an independent transcription: a second person redoes records.second-pass.json from the stored primary source (the checker refuses L2 while both passes name the same transcriber).

Read G.S. 58-3-225 and the NC Department of Insurance page (https://www.ncdoi.gov/insurance-industry/form-and-rate-filings/life-and-health/prompt-pay-requirement): must an insurer pay or respond within 30 calendar days of receiving a claim, and within 30 days after requested information?

Does interest accrue automatically from 30 days after adequate proof of loss, and at what annual rate? The rate is not in the rules reference, so annual_rate_percent is null and interest cannot be computed from this record until it is filled in from the statute.
Are self-funded ERISA plans excluded, and does the rule apply to North Carolina-licensed insurers regardless of provider location?

Store the statute text and the NCDOI page under content/sources/state_prompt_pay/ and re-cite this record to them, quoting the stored files; and replace effective_from 2026-01-01, a placeholder for the first year release 1 prices, with the date the statute's current text took effect.
